hookups.source: https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=GA&parkId=531350 (site details of all 46 'Campsite Electric' sites: 'Electricity Hookup: 50/30' and 'Water Hookup: Y' at every one; 'Sewer Hookup: Y' only at 'Campsite 02 - Host' and 'Campsite 46 - Host'), read 2026-10-29. Sewer cleared: no public site lists it.

values.note: 44 public electric/water RV sites (46 on the booking site, two of them host sites 02 and 46). Every site takes 36 ft or more; 28 are pull-throughs listed at 40-100 ft, the back-ins 36-86 ft (the long figures are driveway lengths as the booking site lists them). 16 primitive tent sites in a separate loop.

sites.source: https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=GA&parkId=531350 (each site's Max Vehicle Length / Driveway Entry) + https://gastateparks.org/DonCarter ('44 Tent, Trailer & RV Campsites', '16 Primitive Tent Campsites'), read 2026-10-29

booking.source: https://gastateparks.org/DonCarter ('Make a Reservation' and the campsite filter links -> gastateparks.reserveamerica.com parkId 531350; 'Reservations 800-864-7275'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: $34 a night for a back-in electric/water site, $38 for a pull-through or host site; the same on a Tuesday and a Saturday in June 2027 and in November 2026. Primitive tent sites $25. Overnight guests pay the daily ParkPass once per vehicle per stay; parking is not included in the reservation. Read 2026-10-29.

fees.source: https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=GA&parkId=531350 (1-night prices for every site on 2027-06-15; sites 03 and 01 also on 2026-11-10 and 2027-06-19: $34.00 / $38.00 Per Night) + https://gastateparks.org/DonCarter ('Overnight guests pay daily ParkPass fee only once per vehicle during their stay, regardless of duration. Parking is not included with reservation.'), read 2026-10-29

note: GA's only state park on Lake Lanier. The RV campground is a gated loop on the overnight peninsula, inland of the Terrapin Cove trail; a separate primitive loop is for tents and hammocks. Two boat ramps, courtesy docks, rentals. --Claude
summary: gastateparks.org + ReserveAmerica (still the engine: the park page's Reserve links go to gastateparks.reserveamerica.com parkId 531350) + park map: 44 public 50/30 A water sites (sewer only at the 2 host sites, so derived sewer:true cleared), 28 pull-throughs, all 36 ft+; $34 back-in / $38 pull-through (weekday = Saturday, Nov 2026 = Jun 2027); showers, laundry, dump. Phone 678-450-7726 matches. Pin ~150 m west of the RV loops, inside tolerance. Not waterfront confirmed: map and imagery put the RV loops inland, the lake beyond the Terrapin Cove trail; the engine carries no waterfront tags. Note trimmed of counts/hookups/booking/ParkPass.
flags: The park closes November 3-4, 2026 for a managed deer quota hunt ('The park will be closed November 3 - 4, 2026 for a managed deer quota hunt', gastateparks.org/DonCarter). Two days only, so no status recorded.
